metas.name: Russell Brand: Open Secret
metas.description: Charts Russell Brand's rise to stardom and subsequent fall after allegations of sexual misconduct.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.

metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon's photographs didn't just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon's archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews w

metas.name: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
metas.description: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

metas.name: Schumacher '94: The Birth of a Legend
metas.description: Follows 25-year-old Michael Schumacher's breakthrough 1994 Formula 1 season, featuring his first Grand Prix win in Brazil and the dramatic events of one of F1's most exciting racing seasons, including Ayrton Senna's accident.

metas.name: Jackass: Best and Last
metas.description: Follows the Jackass crew as they perform their final series of dangerous stunts and pranks, marking the end of the franchise.

metas.name: The Last First: Winter K2
metas.description: K2's first winter ascent claimed 5 lives, revealing modern alpinism's struggles with commercialization, social media impact, and conflicts between marginalized climbers and traditional elites.

metas.name: The Imposter
metas.description: A documentary centered on a young man in Spain who claims to a grieving Texas family that he is their 16-year-old son who has been missing for 3 years.

metas.name: Bill Burr: Drop Dead Years
metas.description: In what might be his most personal and introspective one-hour special yet, comedian Bill Burr offers hilarious takes on everything from male sadness to dating advice.

metas.name: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: The Act of Killing
metas.description: A documentary which challenges former Indonesian death-squad leaders to reenact their mass-killings in whichever cinematic genres they wish, including classic Hollywood crime scenarios and lavish musical numbers.

metas.name: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
metas.description: A filmmaker decides to memorialize a murdered friend when his friend's ex-girlfriend announces she is expecting his son.

metas.name: Tickled
metas.description: Journalist David Farrier stumbles upon a mysterious tickling competition online. As he delves deeper he comes up against fierce resistance, but that doesn't stop him getting to the bottom of a story stranger than fiction.

metas.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft
metas.description: An accompanying 3D concert film, documenting the Manchester shows and co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

metas.name: Exit Through the Gift Shop
metas.description: Following the style of some of the world's most prolific street artists, an amateur filmmaker makes a foray into the art world.

metas.name: Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
metas.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

metas.name: Bo Burnham: Inside
metas.description: A musical comedy special shot and performed by Bo Burnham, alone, over the course of a very unusual year.

metas.name: Harry Potter 20th Anniversary: Return to Hogwarts
metas.description: Cast and crew members from all "Harry Potter" films reunite in a retrospective special to celebrate the 20th anniversary of Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone (2001).

metas.name: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
metas.description: Second City Television cast members reunite in this documentary for a funny and heartfelt celebration of how a scrappy Canadian sketch show made comedy history.

metas.name: Friends: The Reunion
metas.description: The cast of Friends (1994) reunites for a once-in-a-lifetime celebration of the hit series, featuring iconic memories and special guests.

metas.name: The Perfect Neighbor
metas.description: A minor disagreement between neighbors in Florida takes a lethal turn, with police body camera footage and interviews probing the aftermath of the state's controversial "stand your ground" laws.

metas.name: Maternal Instinct
metas.description: When a Texas state trooper pulled over a woman driving erratically on the highway in 2020, she claimed she had just given birth, but her story didn't add up.

metas.name: Free Solo
metas.description: Alex Honnold faces the biggest challenge of his career, climbing El Capitan in Yosemite National Park. He pursues it Free Solo, which means climbing without a rope and alone.

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening e-mails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly-married US Marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Exclusive footage and survivor testimonies chronicle the 2012 sinking of a luxury cruise ship and its aftermath.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: Follows the Mackenzie Shirilla case, a 17-year-old who intentionally crashed her car into a brick wall in Ohio, killing her boyfriend Dominic Russo and his friend Davion Flanagan.

metas.name: Untold UK: Jamie Vardy
metas.description: Jamie Vardy's evolution from part time football player to a Premier League legend.

metas.name: Marty, Life Is Short
metas.description: Follows the definitive documentary on comedian Martin Short, exploring his career across film, television, theater and comedy.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
metas.description: Spanning five decades, Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition charts their iconic rise to become one of the biggest bands in music history.

metas.name: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
metas.description: David Attenborough tells the remarkable story of his first encounter with the baby gorilla Pablo, how that gorilla grew up to be a top Silverback and how Pablo's direct descendants are doing today.

metas.name: S4: The Bob Lazar Story
metas.description: From jet engines to Los Alamos, Bob Lazar's life is rooted in science. In 1988, hired at S4 near Area 51, he reverse-engineered alien tech. Narrated by Lazar, this film uses exclusive footage to reveal America's best-kept secret.

metas.name: The Rise of the Red Hot Chili Peppers
metas.description: Gritty, formative years of the Los Angeles band, and the influence of original guitarist Hillel Slovak, who died in 1988. It features interviews with bandmates Flea and Anthony Kiedis who discuss the band's early evolution.

metas.name: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere
metas.description: The acclaimed documentarian gains rare, unrestricted access to explore a rising ultra-masculine network and its polarizing influencers.

metas.name: Man on the Run
metas.description: An intimate portrait of Paul McCartney's trajectory after The Beatles, as he and his wife Linda form Wings.

metas.name: Epic: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Follows Elvis Presley, featuring never-before-seen footage and recordings.

metas.name: The Investigation of Lucy Letby
metas.description: Unseen footage and unheard insider accounts reveal the harrowing and divisive Case of Lucy Letby, the neonatal nurse convicted of fatally harming infants.

metas.name: Queen of Chess
metas.description: Hungarian chess prodigy Judit Polgár challenges champion Garry Kasparov and her controlling father over 15 years, breaking gender barriers to become the greatest female player ever and one of history's finest.

metas.name: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
metas.description: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

metas.name: Cover-Up
metas.description: Seymour Hersh has been at the front lines of political journalism in the United States. Hersh's breakthrough reportage has brought to the public's attention many of the most damning constitutional wrongdoings and cover-ups.

metas.name: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable
metas.description: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.

metas.name: Breakdown: 1975
metas.description: In 1975, as America faced social and political upheaval, filmmakers turned chaos into art.

metas.name: Murder in Monaco
metas.description: Monaco, 1999: Billionaire banker Edmond Safra is found dead in his penthouse. The documentary examines the puzzling circumstances surrounding this wealthy financier's murder.

metas.name: I'm Chevy Chase and You're Not
The Age of Disclosure
metas.description: Featuring 34 U.S. Government insiders, this explosive documentary reveals an 80-year global cover-up of non-human intelligent life and a secret war among major nations to reverse engineer advanced technology of non-human origin.

metas.name: The Carman Family Deaths
metas.description: A fishing trip ends in tragedy when Linda Carman vanishes at sea leaving her son Nathan adrift for days. His rescue stirs up questions about his grandfather's murder and ignites a battle over inheritance that leads to shocking rev...

metas.name: Come See Me in the Good Light
metas.description: In an intimate and joyful story of love in the face of loss, celebrated poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley find strength—and unexpected hilarity—in what might be their final year together.

metas.name: Being Eddie
metas.description: Follows a comprehensive look at Eddie Murphy's life and career.

metas.name: Aileen: Queen of the Serial Killers
metas.description: Aileen Wuornos killed 7 men while working as a prostitute in Florida (1989-90), claiming self-defense against rape.

metas.name: My Father, the BTK Killer
metas.description: Family man and Scout leader Dennis Rader led a double life as BTK killer. His daughter Kerri Rawson shares her experience with her father's horrific crimes.

metas.name: John Candy: I Like Me
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of iconic funnyman John Candy, who died of a heart attack in 1994, at age 43.

metas.name: All the Empty Rooms
metas.description: A journalist and a photographer set out to memorialize the bedrooms left behind by children killed in school shootings.

metas.name: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish
metas.description: A teen girl and her boyfriend face persistent harassment from an unknown caller. Police investigating the months of torment discover a revelation that upends their initial assumptions.

metas.name: It's Never Over, Jeff Buckley
metas.description: Rising musician Jeff Buckley had only released one album when he died suddenly in 1997. Now, never-before-seen footage, exclusive voice messages, and accounts from those closest to him offer a portrait of the captivating singer.

metas.name: Stolen: Heist of the Century
metas.description: In 2003, elite thieves dubbed 'The School of Turin' pulled off a historic heist at a supposedly unbreakable vault in Antwerp's diamond district, making off with hundreds of millions in gems that remain missing today.

metas.name: Untold: Chess Mates
metas.description: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights h

metas.name: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
metas.description: Follows Miley Cyrus in an interview with Alex Cooper, revisiting the moments, music and memories of Hannah Montana with never-before-seen archival footage and recreated sets from the show.

metas.name: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
metas.description: An inside look at the production process of Stranger Things 5 with Director Martina Radwan, who spent a full year on set documenting the creation of the final season.

metas.name: Trainwreck: Balloon Boy
metas.description: A father claims his son is trapped in a runaway homemade balloon. News helicopters follow the chase live.The empty balloon lands, sparking outrage as the story becomes one of America's most infamous hoaxes.

metas.name: Trainwreck: The Real Project X
metas.description: A Dutch teen's accidental public Facebook party invite goes viral, inspired by Project X movie. Thousands RSVP. Officials ignore warnings. With no entertainment planned, arriving crowds in Haren turn to rioting.

metas.name: Shark Whisperer
metas.description: Marine conservationist and social media activist Ocean Ramsey fearlessly swims with sharks in this documentary about her risky mission to protect them.

metas.name: Trainwreck: The Cult of American Apparel
metas.description: American Apparel rises as a major fashion brand in the 2000s, but its success under CEO Dov Charney masks workplace issues. As financial troubles grow and harassment claims emerge, employees face the reality of a toxic environment.

metas.name: Trainwreck: Poop Cruise
metas.description: A luxury cruise turns disastrous when an engine fire cuts power to the entire ship. 4,000 passengers face failing systems, sewage leaks, and food shortages, sparking passenger unrest and media coverage of "The Poop Cruise."

metas.name: Jaws @ 50: The Definitive Inside Story
metas.description: A tribute to Jaws (1975), the movie that sparked a lasting fascination with the ocean's most misunderstood predator.

metas.name: Trainwreck: Mayor of Mayhem
metas.description: Rob Ford's 2010 Toronto mayoral run shocked critics with an unexpected win. His tenure spiraled into chaos amid mounting scandals and drug allegations, drawing global media attention.

metas.name: Trainwreck: The Astroworld Tragedy
metas.description: Through firsthand accounts from survivors, medics and event workers, the documentary explores the 2021 Astroworld festival disaster and its consequences.

metas.name: Mr. Nobody Against Putin
metas.description: A Russian teacher secretly documents his small town school's transformation into a war recruitment center during the Ukraine invasion, revealing the ethical dilemmas educators face amid propaganda and militarization.

metas.name: Titan: The OceanGate Disaster
metas.description: Titan: The OceanGate Disaster examines CEO Stockton Rush's quest to become the next billionaire innovator and the doomed underwater endeavor that called into question the price of ambition in the depths of the ocean.

metas.name: Vini Jr.
metas.description: Vini Jr. has it all: talent, resilience and boldness. Follow his dancing, unpredictable feet on his inspiring journey to becoming a global soccer star.

metas.name: A Deadly American Marriage
metas.description: A disturbing 911 call and horrific crime scene raise questions about Jason Corbett's death. His family shares memories and hidden realities beneath their perfect-looking life.

metas.name: Ocean with David Attenborough
metas.description: Attenborough explores the planet's undersea habitats, revealing the greatest age of ocean discovery and emphasizing the ocean's vital importance while exposing its problems and highlighting opportunities for marine life recovery.

metas.name: The Seat
metas.description: 'The Seat' is an unprecedented inside look that led to a once-in-a-generation driver change in 'Mercedes' and 'F1' history. It reveals the private conversations that led the 'Mercedes-AMG' F1 team and Toto Wolff (its Team Principa...

metas.name: Oklahoma City Bombing: American Terror
metas.description: Examines the devastating 1995 Oklahoma City federal building bombing - the worst domestic terror attack in US history.

metas.name: Con Mum
metas.description: A chef's world turns chaotic when a globetrotting socialite appears, claiming to be his mother. The documentary uncovers their story.

metas.name: The Twister: Caught in the Storm
metas.description: It is graduation day in Joplin, Missouri. As the Class of 2011 collect their diplomas, their hometown is hit by a rare EF-5 tornado. Believing it could be the end of the world, a group of teenagers find themselves in the eye of th...

metas.name: October 8
metas.description: The emergence of anti-Semitism on college campuses, in social media and on the streets since October 7, 2023, when Hamas attacked Israel.

metas.name: Andrew Schulz: Life
metas.description: Filmed at NYC's Beacon Theatre, Andrew Schulz's new comedy special covers his experiences with starting a family and going through IVF treatments

metas.name: Becoming Led Zeppelin
metas.description: The film traces the journeys of the four members of the Stairway To Heaven rockers through the music scene of the 1960s and their meeting in the summer of 1968, culminating in 1970.

metas.name: The Alabama Solution
metas.description: Incarcerated men defy the odds to expose a cover-up in one of the United States' deadliest prison systems.

metas.name: Don't Die: The Man Who Wants to Live Forever
metas.description: Explores a man's quest for immortality and the lengths he goes to defy aging.

metas.name: Primetime Preacher$
metas.description: Chronicles the 1980s golden age of Christian broadcasting, detailing how three of America's most prominent televangelists shifted evangelical Christianity into a massive political force.

metas.name: When a Witness Recants
metas.description: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

metas.name: Ninho: Fame Ain’t Worth It
metas.description: At the height of his success in 2025, French rap star Ninho considers leaving music behind. This documentary looks back on the triumphs, sacrifices and personal challenges that brought him to that crossroads.

metas.name: Expedition: Saving Our Seas
metas.description: Follows National Geographic Explorers investigating the global Ocean from seashore to seafloor as they chase discoveries and solutions needed to protect the seas amid rapid environmental change.

metas.name: McCartney: The Hunt for the Lost Bass
metas.description: For over fifty years, the disappearance of Paul McCartney’s original Höfner bass has been one of rock ‘n’ roll’s enduring mysteries. The Hunt for the Lost Bass tells the extraordinary story of this iconic instrument, and the fan powered quest to find it.

metas.name: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: Reconnecting with a pack of wolves he has followed for seven years, Bertie sets out to capture one of the Arctic's most dangerous and rarely filmed hunts: wolves taking on a bull moose, prey roughly ten times their size. Led by Kona, a striking white breeding male, the pack faces a critical winter as dwindling food supplies, an encroaching rival wolf and an aging leader threaten its survival.

metas.name: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
metas.description: Investigates Chile's high-profile Caso Relojes ("Watch Case") scandal, in which a suitcase full of smuggled luxury watches and jewelry unmasked an illicit underground network, connecting criminal elements to Chile's social elite.

metas.name: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
metas.description: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: Follows journalist Mariana van Zeller as she goes undercover as a romance scam target to expose a $1 billion criminal industry, teaming with a cyber hacker to confront a scammer posing as a four-star general.

metas.name: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
metas.description: Blurring the line between performance and personal crisis, comedian Maria Bamford turns her mental health journey into material that’s riotously funny and ultimately inspiring. What emerges is a portrait of an artist transforming vulnerability into creative strength through honesty.

metas.name: Man with a Movie Camera
metas.description: A man travels around a city with a camera slung over his shoulder, documenting urban life with dazzling invention.

metas.name: Frankenstein: The Anatomy Lesson
metas.description: Go deep behind the scenes with visionary filmmaker Guillermo del Toro and the "Frankenstein" cast and crew as they give new life to the classic tale.

metas.name: Verdict: The Diddy Trial - ABC News Special
metas.description: Sean Combs was found guilty of transportation to engage in prostitution but acquitted of racketeering and sex trafficking charges. Insiders take us through the legal saga and Comb's next steps.

metas.name: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts
metas.description: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

metas.name: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
metas.description: This documentary recounts Cilvaringz's unlikely rise from fan to Wu-Tang Clan fame — and how the infamous "Once Upon a Time in Shaolin" album came to be.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
metas.description: In July 2026, President Trump disappeared and boarded a different aircraft without anyone noticing. The latest installment of Instadocs pieces together what really happened, as told by the people who were there.

metas.name: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild
metas.description: Instadocs investigates the Hugging Face attack and why this cyberattack may be a warning for humanity's future.

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

metas.name: Clown Panic
metas.description: In 2016, South Carolina children spotted clowns in woods. Reports spread across America, causing lockdowns and probes. Using archival content, and interviews, examines how fear and social media transformed a strange myth into hysteria.
